verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents a public API for building integrations and automating workflows. It lets you programmatically manage datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments and API keys, and offers a downloadable OpenAPI spec for your own tooling. Markers are also documented as manageable via curl or the honeymarker CLI. The probe's 404s on guessed OpenAPI paths only mean the spec isn't at a well-known discoverable URL; they don't contradict the documented download. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API, and a machine-discoverable OpenAPI spec at a standard path.
